title: Single-Server M/M/1 Bank Teller Queue
description: Classic single-server bank teller queueing system using GPSS GENERATE, QUEUE/DEPART, SEIZE/RELEASE, ADVANCE, and TERMINATE blocks.
code:
* MODEL: BankTellerMM1
* Single-Server Bank Teller M/M/1 Queueing Simulation
      GENERATE 6,2          ; Customers arrive every 6 +/- 2 minutes
      QUEUE    LOBBY        ; Join teller waiting line
      SEIZE    TELLER1      ; Capture single bank teller
      DEPART   LOBBY        ; Leave waiting line
      ADVANCE  5,2          ; Transaction service takes 5 +/- 2 minutes
      RELEASE  TELLER1      ; Free bank teller
      TERMINATE 1           ; Customer departs bank
      START    200          ; Simulate 200 completed customers
      END

title: Multi-Server M/M/c Emergency Room
description: Hospital emergency department with multiple treatment bays modeled as a GPSS STORAGE pool, exponential interarrival FUNCTION, and waiting-time TABLE.
code:
* MODEL: EmergencyRoomMMc
* Multi-Server Hospital Emergency Room with Exponential Arrivals & Wait Table
BAYS  STORAGE 4
EXPON FUNCTION RN1,C4
0,0/.5,.693/.9,2.303/.99,4.605
WAIT_T TABLE M1,5,5,20
      GENERATE 8,FN$EXPON   ; Patients arrive exponentially (mean 8 min)
      QUEUE    TRIAGE_Q     ; Enter waiting room
      ENTER    BAYS,1       ; Occupy one of 4 treatment bays
      DEPART   TRIAGE_Q     ; Leave waiting room
      ADVANCE  26,FN$EXPON  ; Treatment duration (mean 26 min)
      LEAVE    BAYS,1       ; Vacate treatment bay
      TABULATE WAIT_T       ; Record total time in ER
      TERMINATE 1           ; Patient discharged
      START    250          ; Simulate 250 patients
      END

title: Manufacturing Job Shop with Priority Preemption
description: CNC machining center serving regular production orders while urgent rush jobs preempt the machine via GPSS PREEMPT and RETURN blocks.
code:
* MODEL: JobShopPriority
* CNC Machining Center with Regular Production & High-Priority Rush Orders
CYCLE TABLE M1,10,10,20
      GENERATE 15,5,,,1     ; Regular production jobs (priority 1)
      QUEUE    CNC_Q        ; Wait for CNC mill
      SEIZE    CNC_MILL     ; Acquire CNC mill
      DEPART   CNC_Q        ; Leave queue
      ADVANCE  12,3         ; Machining cycle (12 +/- 3 min)
      RELEASE  CNC_MILL     ; Free CNC mill
      TABULATE CYCLE        ; Record cycle time
      TERMINATE 1           ; Regular job complete

      GENERATE 60,15,,,5    ; Urgent rush jobs (priority 5)
      QUEUE    CNC_Q        ; Jump ahead in priority queue
      SEIZE    CNC_MILL     ; Capture CNC mill with higher priority
      DEPART   CNC_Q        ; Leave queue
      ADVANCE  8,2          ; Rush machining operation
      RELEASE  CNC_MILL     ; Free CNC mill
      TERMINATE 1           ; Rush job complete

      START    150          ; Simulate 150 total jobs
      END

title: Automated Warehouse AGV Forklift Dispatch
description: Automated distribution center coordinating AGV forklift fleets, battery charging logic switches, and aisle traffic control using GPSS STORAGE, LOGIC, and GATE blocks.
code:
* MODEL: WarehouseAGVDispatch
* Automated Warehouse AGV Fleet with Aisle Gate & Dock Capacity Control
AGVS  STORAGE 6
DOCKS STORAGE 3
PICK_T TABLE M1,5,5,25
      GENERATE 4,1          ; Pallet pick orders arrive every 4 +/- 1 min
      QUEUE    ORDER_Q      ; Wait for available AGV
      ENTER    AGVS,1       ; Dispatch one AGV forklift
      DEPART   ORDER_Q      ; Leave order queue
      GATE NU  AISLE        ; Wait until main aisle facility is free
      SEIZE    AISLE        ; Lock main aisle for transit
      ADVANCE  2,1          ; Traverse main aisle
      RELEASE  AISLE        ; Release main aisle lock
      QUEUE    DOCK_Q       ; Wait for outbound loading dock
      ENTER    DOCKS,1      ; Acquire loading dock
      DEPART   DOCK_Q       ; Leave dock queue
      ADVANCE  7,2          ; Unload pallet onto trailer
      LEAVE    DOCKS,1      ; Free loading dock
      ADVANCE  3,1          ; Return AGV to staging zone
      LEAVE    AGVS,1       ; Return AGV to fleet pool
      TABULATE PICK_T       ; Record order fulfillment time
      TERMINATE 1           ; Order fulfilled
      START    300          ; Simulate 300 pallet orders
      END

title: Multi-Stage Port Container Terminal Crane-Truck Simulation
description: End-to-end maritime container terminal modeling vessel berthing, quay crane unloading, customs inspection branching via probabilistic TRANSFER, and yard drayage truck dispatch.
code:
* MODEL: PortContainerTerminal
* Multi-Stage Container Terminal: Quay Cranes, Yard Trucks & Customs Inspection
CRANES STORAGE 4
TRUCKS STORAGE 8
GATES  STORAGE 2
EXPON  FUNCTION RN1,C4
0,0/.5,.693/.9,2.303/.99,4.605
DWELL  TABLE M1,15,15,24
      GENERATE 5,FN$EXPON   ; Container lift demand arrives
      QUEUE    QUAY_Q       ; Wait for quay gantry crane
      ENTER    CRANES,1     ; Assign gantry crane
      DEPART   QUAY_Q       ; Leave quay queue
      ADVANCE  4,1          ; Lift container from vessel to chassis
      QUEUE    TRUCK_Q      ; Wait for yard drayage truck
      ENTER    TRUCKS,1     ; Capture yard truck
      DEPART   TRUCK_Q      ; Leave truck queue
      LEAVE    CRANES,1     ; Release gantry crane for next lift
      ADVANCE  6,2          ; Haul container to yard stack
      TRANSFER 0.15,YARD_OUT,CUSTOMS ; 15% routed to customs X-ray inspection
CUSTOMS SEIZE  XRAY_SCAN    ; Acquire customs X-ray bay
      ADVANCE  12,4         ; Perform customs scan
      RELEASE  XRAY_SCAN    ; Free customs X-ray bay
YARD_OUT QUEUE GATE_Q       ; Approach terminal exit gate
      ENTER    GATES,1      ; Acquire exit gate lane
      DEPART   GATE_Q       ; Leave gate queue
      ADVANCE  3,1          ; Process gate-out manifest
      LEAVE    GATES,1      ; Free exit gate lane
      LEAVE    TRUCKS,1     ; Return yard truck to pool
      TABULATE DWELL        ; Record container terminal dwell time
      TERMINATE 1           ; Container exits terminal
      START    400          ; Simulate 400 containers
      END
